title: Relying on Allah While Job Hunting
paragraphs: Setelah menganggur selama empat bulan, Samir mulai merasa bahwa situasinya sepenuhnya bergantung pada keberuntungan, melamar pekerjaan demi pekerjaan dengan harapan yang semakin menipis setiap kalinya. Seorang mentor mengingatkannya bahwa meski usaha adalah tanggung jawabnya sendiri, hasil sesungguhnya pada akhirnya berada di tangan Allah semata, dan mempercayai ini tidak berarti ia harus berhenti berusaha semaksimal mungkin.

Samir mulai melamar dengan pola pikir yang lebih tenang, fokus mengerjakan setiap lamaran dengan teliti alih-alih cemas menyegarkan emailnya setiap beberapa menit berharap respons segera. Ketika tawaran akhirnya datang melalui koneksi tak terduga yang hampir ia lupakan, Samir menyadari bahwa perubahan pola pikirnya membuat masa penantian jauh lebih tertahankan, terlepas dari hasil akhirnya.
answerKey: After being unemployed for four months, Samir was starting to feel that his situation depended entirely on luck, applying to job after job with less and less genuine hope each time. A mentor reminded him that while effort was his own responsibility, the actual outcome ultimately rested with Allah alone, and that trusting this did not mean he should stop trying his best. Samir began applying with a calmer mindset, focusing on doing each application thoroughly rather than anxiously refreshing his email every few minutes hoping for an immediate response. When an offer finally came through an unexpected connection he had almost forgotten about, Samir realized that his changed mindset had made the waiting period far more bearable, regardless of the eventual outcome.
